summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi GME 2x Daily ETF (GMEC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of GameStop Corp. (GME) which operates as the largest brick-and-mortar and e-commerce specialty retailer of video games, gaming hardware, consumer electronics, and pop-culture collectibles. GMEC was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
